title: NTA UGC NET
fullName: National Testing Agency — University Grants Commission National Eligibility Test
titleHi: UGC NET परीक्षा पैटर्न और सिलेबस
overview: UGC NET is conducted for determining the eligibility of Indian nationals for Assistant Professor and Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Indian universities and colleges.

Paper II: 80 subjects including Economics, Political Science, Philosophy, Psychology, Sociology, History, Anthropology, Commerce, Education, Social Work, Defence Studies, Women Studies, Computer Science, Electronics Science, etc.
